message.reasoning:
We need to compute inventory value = quantity in stock * unit price for SKU A. We have tools inventory and price. Must first call inventory with sku "A", then call price with sku "A". Then compute value. Then return JSON with sku and inventory_value. Must not invent stock or price. So we need to call both tools. Then combine results. However, the system says we can only do one tool call per turn? Actually it says "In each turn you can either: - Send a message to the user. - Make a tool call. You cannot do both at the same time." So we can only make one tool call per turn. But we need both inventory and price. Possibly we can call one tool, get result, then call the other tool in subsequent turn, then compute and respond. The user asked: "What is the inventory value of SKU A? Use inventory and price before calculating." So we need to do multi-step: first call inventory, then price, then compute. We can do tool calls sequentially. In each turn, we can only call one tool. So we need to call inventory first, then get result, then call price, then get result, then compute and respond with JSON.

Thus first step: call inventory with sku "A".
